title: The men running the deportation machine are quietly getting rich off it
body: The Lever reports that Homeland Security Secretary Markwayne Mullin got a tax break on up to $8.6 million in stock sales, with nearly half of it in companies that hold contracts with the department he now runs. He sold the shares to clear conflicts of interest. The reward for doing that was a certificate of divestiture from the Office of Government Ethics, which let him defer the capital gains taxes as long as he parks the money in something like Treasury bonds. Sell to dodge a conflict, skip the tax bill. Only federal officials get that deal.

The Lever also finds that as ICE funnels millions into private prison firms like GEO Group and CoreCivic, President Trump has been trading their stocks. The same government that decides how many people to lock up is run by people who own pieces of the companies paid to lock them up. The incentive is not hidden - it sits right on the balance sheet.
When the people setting immigration policy are also holding the stock, the cruelty is not a side effect, it's the business model.
